summary: Phase 3 variants layer backend testing — 15/15 pytest tests passed against the preview backend. Verified startup migration (7 items backfilled per backend log: 'variants bootstrap: backfilled=7 merged_duplicates=0'), GET /api/items and /api/items/{id} include populated variants array, POST /api/items auto-generates variants from sizes x colors with even qty split and unique ids (also verified single-color and no-colors cases + explicit variants preserved verbatim), PATCH sizes/colors regenerates variants while preserving qty + price_cents_override for retained (size,color) combos and drops removed combos, POST /api/payments/checkout resolves variant from variant_id AND from size+color fallback (variant_id persisted on order document), returns 409 on disabled variant and 409 on quantity=0. GET /api/items excludes items with merged_into (only 200 non-merged items returned, all with unique ids). Subscription endpoints unaffected: /api/subs/health=200, /api/subs/pay-web=200 (HTML), /api/subs/webhook=401 without signature, /api/subs/checkout=401 without auth (both endpoints reachable and enforce guards).
critical_code_review_comments: core/variants.py:generate_variants — quantity split logic is correct: divmod(base_qty, n_colors) with extras distributed to earliest colors so per-size row totals stay consistent with SizeOption.available_qty (verified via test_auto_generate_variants_from_sizes_x_colors).

routers/items.py:patch_item — when sizes or colors change, generate_variants(existing=doc.get('variants')) is invoked so seller edits to quantity/price_cents_override survive across catalog edits (verified via test_patch_sizes_regenerates_and_preserves_qty).

routers/payments.py — variant lookup precedence is variant_id → (size, color) fallback with disabled/OOS pre-checks returning 409 before hitting Paystack. order.variant_id is persisted for later stock decrement.

routers/items.py:duplicate_item does NOT generate variants for the clone (missing from the duplicate() dict) — this is a minor gap: cloned items lose their variants array until the seller PATCHes sizes/colors or the next boot backfill runs. Not covered in this iteration's scope but worth flagging for a follow-up.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and delete their own TEST_-prefixed items via seller session so seed catalog is untouched. Buyer address auto-created if none present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://fit-finder-app-5.preview.emergentagent.com. Seller (atelier@aurafit.com) + Buyer (buyer@aurafit.com) creds confirmed working. Backend startup event 'bootstrap_item_variants' migrated 7 legacy items on first boot post-deploy; subsequent boots are no-ops (idempotent). Note: items/duplicate_item route in routers/items.py does not include variants in the clone dict — flagged as a minor pre-existing gap not in scope for Phase 3 acceptance.
